To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the nursing workplace has a negative impact on the mental health of some nurses, that the nursing workplace is not conducive to good mental health, that mental illness is a serious issue for nursing, and that nurses need support to deal with their mental health.
mental illness is common in the nursing workplace.

nurses are more likely to develop mental illness if they are vulnerable to it prior to entering the nursing profession, if they develop mental illness that is not directly related to their nursing practice but which is nevertheless affected by it, and if they develop mental health conditions as a result of their nursing practice.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mental health and wellbeing of nurses and the need for nurses to be able to access mental health services that are responsive to their particular needs.
the impact of mental illness on nurses, and how the nursing profession can support nurses with mental illness to remain in the profession and continue to contribute to its future development.
how mental illness is experienced by the individual and by nurses as a collective group.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the nursing profession is in a state of crisis, and that the mental health of the nursing workforce is in need of urgent attention.
mental illness is a significant and pervasive problem in nursing and that it has a profound impact on the lives of nurses and those who care for them.
nurses who have experienced a mental health issue are at risk of being bullied, and that this bullying can have a detrimental effect on their mental health.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
mental illness in nursing is a problem, and it is a problem that is not well understood.
nurses’ mental health and wellbeing are not a priority for the profession or employers.
mental illness is a complex phenomenon and that nurses are at risk of developing mental illness as a consequence of their work.
The main takeaway from our work is that
mental illness is not a sign of weakness but a normal part of the human condition.
nurses’ mental health is a priority and needs attention.
nurses’ mental health is a significant issue in nursing, and that the profession, employers and nurses need to take a more proactive approach to addressing this issue.
